basic_info.description: This top floor residence is perched atop Russian Hill and enjoys views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Palace of Fine Arts, and western views towards the Presidio. The unit is appointed with two bedrooms, two baths, approx. 925 sqft and has been thoughtfully renovated throughout including double paned windows. The open floor plan living and dining area overlook the sweeping views and seamlessly flow into the kitchen. The kitchen has been designed with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, a moveable island, quartz countertops, and a sink overlooking the view. The spacious primary suite enjoys a bay window and an en-suite bathroom. Down the hall is the second bedroom, a full bath, and in-unit laundry. The unit includes one car parking and additional storage. This boutique 7-unit building was built in 1911 and maintains its beautiful original character. Located on a picturesque tree-lined street within a short walk of popular restaurants and shops, including Bi-Rite Market.
